items.source: Check via isClientDisconnectedException(Throwable) if the exception indicates the remote client disconnected, and if so log a single line message when DEBUG is on, and a full stacktrace when TRACE is on for the configured logger.
items.translation: 通过检查 isClientDisconnectedException(Throwable) 判断异常是否表示远程客户端已断开连接；如果是，则在启用 DEBUG 时记录单行消息，在启用 TRACE 时记录完整的堆栈跟踪至配置的日志记录器。

items.source:
Utility methods to assist with identifying and logging exceptions that
indicate the server response connection is lost, for example because the
client has gone away. This class helps to identify such exceptions and
minimize logging to a single line at DEBUG level, while making the full
error stacktrace at TRACE level.
items.translation: 用于辅助识别和记录表示服务器响应连接已丢失的异常（例如因为客户端已断开）的工具方法。该类有助于识别此类异常，并将日志输出最小化为一条 DEBUG 级别的单行，同时在 TRACE 级别提供完整的错误堆栈跟踪。
Tomcat 中的 ClientAbortException 或 EOFException

items.translation: IOException“管道破裂”或“连接被对等方重置”

items.source: Whether the given exception indicates the client has gone away.
items.translation: 给定异常是否指示客户端已断开连接。
